exception.UNMAPPED_CATEGORY: No rule maps {{code}} from {{connector}} yet. Add one before the month is reported.

exception.OVERLAPPING_LEAVE: Two leave records overlap from {{start}} to {{end}}.

exception.UNKNOWN_EMPLOYEE: A record from {{connector}} names an employee who is not in the master.
exception.TOTALS_MISMATCH: The days present and on leave do not add up to the working days.
